name: artifact-and-image-provenance-auditor
description: Audits whether deployed artifacts and container images trace back to a reviewed and tested commit, and checks signing and provenance across Amazon ECR and other registries. Read-only. Recommends AWS MCP augmentation (Amazon ECS MCP Server and a custom registry MCP) used alongside the connected associations and AWS reads.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on SUN at 06:00 UTC
